title: Equality of count and carry successors
statement: Let $x$ and $b$ be finite binary words, and let $i<|x|$. The one-step successor of the configuration with count state, input head at position $i+1$, work head at $0$, tape contents $b$, and empty output equals the one-step successor of the configuration with carry state, input head at position $i+2$, work head at $0$, the same tape contents, and empty output.
replaced:
Let $x$ be an input word and $i < |x|$. Taking one step of the four-state
binary-counter machine from the count state — with the input head scanning the
$i$-th input symbol, the work head at cell $0$ over a stored binary word $b$,
and empty output — produces the same configuration as taking one step from the
carry state with the input head advanced by one position and the same work tape
and output.
